card.name: Digit 1 inside section numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 1 (sometimes 2) right after a decimal point in section or verse citations, such as (8.1, 8.3) or (7.1). It is most common in label cross-references and also appears in scripture and journal references.

modes.label: Label cross-references
modes.description: The digit after the dot in a bracketed section number pointing to another part of a drug label.

modes.label: Scripture and journal citations
modes.description: The digit after the dot in verse numbers or DOI-style references.
